WITH ref AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS ref_date
  FROM orders
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= ref.ref_date - INTERVAL '89 days'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < ref.ref_date + INTERVAL '1 day';
